title: Uglies
author: Scott Westerfeld
summary: In a future where everyone is given a perfect new face at sixteen, a girl counting the days until her operation is pushed to betray her best friend's escape. She is sent after a hidden community that rejects the surgery.
readIf: you like easy, quick young-adult dystopias that ask what beauty standards do to people.
skipIf: you want a layered or subtle story, since the message is clear and the world fairly light.

pairings.reason: A quieter, older young-adult dystopia about a society that smooths away pain at a hidden cost.
A darker, more morally complicated young-adult story set in a perfect-looking future.
